Portfolio workspace — before and after

Captured 24 October 2026 against the live development app.

Before — separate destinations

Repositories: a wide data grid with a separate filter panel and centered add dialog.

All Time Insights: portfolio totals, growth, language mix and activity on a separate route.

Code Health: another separate destination and page header.

① Repeated navigation and page headings. ② Context switching between related portfolio data. ③ Wide table interactions on mobile.

After — consolidated Portfolio workspace

After — mobile repository cards

Audit result

  • Desktop add-repository dialog is a right-side drawer; mobile remains viewport-bound.
  • Health analysis returned all 21 repositories in the consolidated tab.
  • Insights, Code Health, Year in Review, Settings and repository detail passed the route sweep.
  • Focused responsive/accessibility tests: 8 passed. Solution build: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
